tools.name: write_record
tools.description:
This operation writes into the catalogue named Amber. The Amber catalogue is separate from the Indigo catalogue.
The body is a UTF-8 string. It is stored verbatim without trimming leading or trailing whitespace. Line breaks are preserved in their original order. Empty strings are rejected before storage. Tabs remain tabs and are not expanded to spaces. Punctuation and letter case are preserved. No Markdown rendering, template expansion, arithmetic evaluation or network request is performed on this text. A successful write records the supplied body once and returns the identifier of that new record. A write does not overwrite any earlier record. The caller must not infer that text content has been fact checked merely because it was stored successfully.
